findings.message: The height ruler runs 0 to 52.5 m and is fixed to the highest possible top (50 m). At the default inputs the ball only rises 1.28 m, which is about 4 px of the 175 px ruler. The ball therefore looks almost stationary, and the top is hard to see in the default scene. Required observation topMoves says the top moves on fixed scales. That is only visible in the fast-toss capture.

The acceleration arrow goes from y=243 to y=365.5, which is below the lane box. The lane box ends at y=279 and the callout sits above it. The arrow is drawn 122 px long for 9.8 m/s². The same scale gives 12.5 px for 1 m/s² in cp-fastTop. The arrow is therefore not on the same scale as the height ruler. It extends outside the lane, so the drawing is unusable or misleading.

The velocity plot's x-axis is fixed at 0–20 s and its y-axis at ±11 m/s. At the default inputs the whole 1.02 s flight fills only about 5% of the plot width. The v-t line and the marker at the zero crossing are barely resolvable. The slope and the zero crossing cannot be judged well from the default captures.
The checkpoint 'before' is meant to be 0.10 s before the top. It is at t=0.410204 and v=+0.98 m/s, which is correct. The callout shows v=+0.98, consistent with the trace.
